evidence: NOTE: palimnex.tests.test_ontology_shadow 17/17 passed. Contract validator status valid for the channel implementation receipt. Strict mypy on palimnex/ontology_shadow.py reported no issues.

NOTE: ontology_channel refuses registry_kind other than approved_registry with registry_kind_mismatch. registry is None yields an empty channel. Contributing ids are recognized, unambiguous, and have at least one verified binding. Ambiguous, stale, and uncovered ids are listed in excluded_* and never scored.

NOTE: build_shadow_comparison emits pointers and digests only. Independent probe: query text absent from the document; digest tamper raises comparison_digest_mismatch; retrieval_influence, returned_ranking_changed, and authorizes_actions stay false; authority is evidence_only.

NOTE: Secret query refused as query_privacy_refused without echoing the query. R7 symlink refusal propagates as a typed ShadowComparisonError without path echo. scan_bytes findings on a bound source refuse as source_privacy_refused.

MINOR: Runtime _CONCEPT_ID_RE is [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)* with no length bound, while schema $defs.conceptId has minLength 3 and maxLength 128. After rehashing, validate_shadow_comparison accepts concept id ab and a 129-character id; Draft 2020-12 rejects both. The builder emits only concept-registry ids, which already satisfy 3-128. Unsorted ids fail runtime as ordering_or_duplicate while the schema accepts them.

NOTE: A verified empty byte range is contributing with an empty ranking, matching docs/ONTOLOGY_SHADOW.md (empty byte ranges overlap no chunk). Ranking is (-score, pointer) capped at MAX_ONTOLOGY_CANDIDATES 512.
source_grounding_result: Channel ranking uses match_aliases and verify_source_bindings. A chunk qualifies when a contributing approved concept has a verified repo binding whose inclusive line range overlaps the chunk. Byte ranges convert from current file bytes; empty byte ranges overlap no chunk. Non-repo verified bindings can establish contribution and do not map to repository chunks.
privacy_result: Query and source privacy admission run before derivation. Refusals are ShadowComparisonError with reason and field only. Comparison documents carry query_digest and never the raw query, source text, or excerpts. Pointers and paths are scan_text gated.
retrieval_quality_result: Score is distinct contributing concepts overlapping a chunk. Sort is descending score then ascending pointer. Cap 512 with truncated disclosure. Candidate registries never rank. Ambiguous, stale, and uncovered concepts never contribute.
compatibility_result: Adds palimnex:ontology-shadow-comparison:v1, OntologyChannel, ontology_channel, build_shadow_comparison, and validate_shadow_comparison. Existing retrieval identifiers are unchanged. MINOR validator-versus-schema gap on concept-id length; runtime is stricter on list ordering.
rollback_result: Delete palimnex/ontology_shadow.py, palimnex/tests/test_ontology_shadow.py, palimnex/schemas/ontology-shadow-comparison.v1.schema.json, and docs/ONTOLOGY_SHADOW.md, and revert the channel implementation receipt. Retrieval.py currently imports this module, so rollback of the channel alone would break that import until retrieval.py is also reverted.
authority_result: Every comparison hard-codes retrieval_influence false, returned_ranking_changed false, authority evidence_only, and authorizes_actions false. No approved registry is created. No configuration switch exists.
limitations: Concept-id length parity was probed with rehashed documents; the builder cannot emit those ids from a valid registry.
